title: Omni Foundation Qualification Record
description: Formal owner-attested qualification record for the Omni foundation gate (OMNI-IMP-0.0.0.13). Separates technical CI outcomes from governance approval.

commit_sha.description: Exact Git commit SHA that was qualified.

technical_status.description: Result of the full CI validation run (fmt, clippy, build, test).

verified_item_count.description: Number of mandatory inventory items with Verified status at the time of qualification.

total_mandatory_items.description: Total count of mandatory inventory items.

verified_gaps.description: List of mandatory items that are not yet Verified. Empty array means all mandatory items are Verified.

formal_status.description: Governance-level formal sign-off status. 'approved' means the project owner has attested the qualification record.

attester.description: Identity of the person/body attesting formal qualification.

attestation_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the formal attestation was recorded.

items.description: Human-readable reason why each remaining item is blocked.

blocked_reasons.description: Why mandatory items are not yet Verified. Corresponds to D-001 style discrepancies.

spec_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the spec tree at qualification time, to prevent post-hoc changes.
